items.title: Show HN: VOSR 2 image upscaling, in the browser
items.contentSnippet:
Hey everyone, I’ve been interested in AI image upscaling for years, but running these models locally usually requires setting up complicated development environments. I used AI to port VOSR2 to WebGPU so anyone can run it directly in their browser.
You’ll still need a fairly powerful machine, such as a modern Mac, but the results are comparable to Topaz, and it’s free. I’d love to hear what you think.

items.title: Show HN: I forked JetBrains' new agent IDE to host Claude Code
items.contentSnippet:
ThinkRail is JetBrains' open-source IDE shell for AI coding agents: worktree-per-tab, chat + file tree + terminal, but hardwired to one agent (Pi).
My fork adds a plugin API so it can host others too, starting with Claude Code running in the same UI.
What's new over upstream:
- A prototype of real plugin system
- Claude Code as a first-class citizen — config, IDE bridge, and terminal status all wired in as a builtin plugin, so you get Claude Code sessions in the same worktree-scoped UI as `pi`.

items.contentSnippet:

items.title: Show HN: Browse last quarter's Supreme Court cases, linked and cited as you read
items.contentSnippet:
I made this as a means to browse through documents that are highly linked and referential in general, and thought it would be interesting to apply it to court cases. So this has the opinion, the arguments per person, the dissents, and concurrences all mapped out.
It also is linked to an LLM you can chat about them with if you click a linkage and it has a DAG of the knowledge of all the content of both pieces and their premises, and can discuss, debate, or do deeper research and opining.
